name: Drakun x Demon! I'll become the strongest mage in the world!
source:
When an aspiring young man comes face to face with the appearance of a terrorist organization, can he become strong enough to protect Autumn city and those he cares about?

Drakun X Demon takes place in the fictional city of Autumn City. The existence of magic and demons is commonplace in this world. While some demons live among humans in peace, some demons are petty trouble-makers or wanted criminals. "The Organization" is a government law enforcement agency that deals specifically with these supernatural cases.

Join Hiro, Kana, and Angie as they defeat demons in their everyday life in different situations.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/inoribotnsfw]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
当恐怖组织现身，一名胸怀抱负的青年，能否变得足够强大，守护秋城与自己在乎的人？

《Drakun X Demon》的舞台是虚构城市秋城。在这个世界里，魔法与恶魔的存在都司空见惯。有些恶魔与人类和平共处，有些却是惹是生非的麻烦制造者，或遭到通缉的罪犯。“组织”是政府的执法机构，专门处理这类超自然案件。

与Hiro、Kana和安吉一同，在日常生活的各种情境中击败恶魔。

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/inoribotnsfw]Patreon[/url]]
